_comment: AMP interface contract for the F1/X1 AMP project (amp_conversion Gate A). Authoritative machine-readable mirror of humanoid/algo/amp/motion_lib.py + x1_amp_env.py. State/amp_contract.json (Kernel-managed) should mirror this. All expert/policy quantities share identical dim/order/frame/units; velocities differ only by estimation method (expert=finite-diff of mocap, policy=sim state) which is the standard AMP convention.

robot.name: AgiBot X1 (project codename 'F1'; legs-only locomotion model)

amp_observation.frame: base (pelvis) frame; xyzw quaternion; world gravity (0,0,-9.81)

expert_transition.source: retargeted mocap clip npz {root_translation(N,3), root_rotation(N,4 xyzw), joint_positions(N,12 X1-order), foot_contact(N,2), fps}
expert_transition.loader: motion_lib.MotionLib (resample->100Hz, finite/joint-range checks, builds N-1 AMP rows)
expert_transition.smoke_source: data/smoke_expert/walk_smoke.npz (SYNTHETIC, Gate-A only; NOT the Gate-B retargeted expert)

policy_transition.collection: compute_amp_obs() each env step -> AMPReplayBuffer (circular, cap 1e6)

discriminator.loss: softplus GAN: expert_loss=softplus(-D(e)); policy_loss=softplus(D(p)); + R1 grad penalty (coef 5.0) on policy

style_reward.mixing: added to env reward BEFORE process_env_step so GAE/returns see it; style_weight=1.0

task_reward: inherited X1 gait/velocity reward set (x1_dh_stand); AMP cfg down-weights tracking_lin_vel 2.5->1.5, ref_joint_pos 0.6->0.3 to leave room for style reward
normalization: cfg.normalization.obs_scales (lin_vel 2, ang_vel 1, dof_pos 1, dof_vel 0.05, quat 1); clip_observations 100; clip_actions 100. AMP features use raw sim/finite-diff values (not rescaled) for the discriminator, matching the expert.

checkpoint_export.save: AMPOnPolicyRunner.save: actor_critic + PPO optimizer + state_estimator_optimizer + disc + disc_optimizer + expert_logit_ema + policy_buffer_state{size} + iter
checkpoint_export.resume: load() restores all of the above (buffer intentionally resets to empty: no learned state, refills per iteration; avoids all-zero-sample corruption)
checkpoint_export.export: JIT via scripts/export_policy_dh.py; ONNX via scripts/export_onnx_dh.py (observation/action contract identical to train)

gate_a_evidence.amp_smoke_result: SMOKE OK; disc_param_mean_delta=3.497e-04 finite=True; ckpt save+resume(disc/EMA match)+play verified; SDK Completed ret:True
gate_a_evidence.ppo_baseline_smoke_result: SMOKE OK; runner=DHOnPolicyRunner (plain PPO, NOT AMP); ppo_param_mean_delta=2.656e-03 finite=True; ckpt save+resume+play; ckpt carries NO disc_state_dict (plain); value_loss 0.0104->0.0011; SDK Completed ret:True
gate_a_evidence.headless_contract_test: test_amp_contract.py PASS 21/21 (explicit expert/policy schema auto-comparison: shared builder + shared default dof vec, no NaN/Inf, exact shapes; report data/smoke_expert/contract_test_result.json)
gate_a_evidence.headless_algo_smoke: amp_algo_smoke_numpy.py PASS 10/10 (disc updates mean|delta|=4.68e-02, loss 4.354->0.065, acc 0.994, style-reward sign correct: expert 0.988 > fake 0.000, monotonic)
gate_a_evidence.baseline_preserved: x1_dh_stand (DHOnPolicyRunner) registered & unchanged; AMP task x1_amp (AMPOnPolicyRunner) independent, not a rename
